Build an isotropic resistance (friction) surface

Source: R/fn_cost.R
build_resistance.Rd

Lifted from safeHavens buildResistanceSurface() (terra-only). Sums weighted, optional layers - water features, terrain ruggedness, habitat and any extras - into a per-cell cost of movement, clamped to a floor of 1 and stored as integer. Feed the result to cost_distance for Dr.

Usage

build_resistance(
  base_raster,
  resistance_surface = NULL,
  oceans = NULL,
  lakes = NULL,
  rivers = NULL,
  tri = NULL,
  habitat = NULL,
  w_ocean = 100,
  w_lakes = 50,
  w_rivers = 20,
  w_tri = 1,
  w_habitat = 1,
  addtl_r = NULL,
  addtl_w = NULL
)

Arguments

base_raster

SpatRaster giving template geometry/resolution.

resistance_surface

optional precomputed resistance; if given, the builder arguments are ignored (geometry must match base_raster).

oceans, lakes, rivers

binary (0/1) SpatRasters of water features.

tri

continuous terrain-ruggedness SpatRaster (z-scored internally).

habitat

continuous SpatRaster whose high values raise cost; for a dispersal surface pass inverted suitability (e.g. 1 - suitability) so movement through good habitat is cheap.

w_ocean, w_lakes, w_rivers, w_tri, w_habitat

weights applied to each layer.

addtl_r

extra SpatRaster stack; addtl_w their weights (same length as terra::nlyr(addtl_r)).

addtl_w

see addtl_r.

Value

an integer SpatRaster of movement cost (minimum 1).
